_note: v3: the five checks follow the five evaluation topics. Order inside each check is ALWAYS Salesforce first, then HubSpot. Every claim renders its source footnote. HubSpot absence claims use 'doesn't offer' / 'doesn't document', never 'can't'. Edition names and per-seat pricing appear ONLY in the cost check's microsite detail and the calculator, never in headlines.
